A second figure, likely an umpire or coach, is partially visible in the bottom right corner wearing a dark shirt and cap. The background consists of the green outfield grass with mowing patterns and the brown infield dirt.

The curved line separating the infield dirt from the grass appears slightly warped and inconsistent with standard baseball field geometry, suggesting minor perspective hallucination.
